##### Doing a small number of things at high quality,

over trying to do everything or arbitrary deadlines.

![Blue Octopus icon with red circle and white heart inside](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/686x430/731a2cd765/value-respect-img.jpg/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))

##### Doing the right thing by our customers and team,

over short-term gain.

![Blue Octopus icon with a green signal emitting from it](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/686x430/ac7c2f48d2/value-openness-img.jpg/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))

##### Listening to our customers,

over following market trends.

![3 Octopus icons with cog icon in the background](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/686x430/cddc72ddf0/value-helping-each-other.jpg/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))

##### Helping each other,

over being efficient individual contributors.

![Octopus icon in a timer](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/686x430/c2a3aa0a7e/value-bias-for-action.jpg/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))

##### A bias for action,

over risk aversion or the pursuit of the perfect plan.

![Pink person icon](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/79x76/1ad238eb7a/benefits-retirement-pension.svg)

##### You'll thank us later

Plan for your future with our comprehensive retirement or pension plans.

[Read more](https://handbook.octopus.com/life-octopus/leave#retirement-funds)

![Pink palm tree](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/78x76/8e8576c458/benefits-annual-leave2.svg)

##### Recharge and thrive with generous leave

25 days of paid annual leave, 10 sick days, parental leave, and more.

[Read more](https://handbook.octopus.com/life-octopus/leave)

![Hand holding soil with a plant growing from it](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/78x76/a8c522a5f1/benefits-grow-your-potential2.svg)

##### Grow your potential

Personal, leadership, and career development with clear career pathways for every individual.

[Read more](https://handbook.octopus.com/life-octopus/career)

![Pink and white tooth](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/78x76/82da296a7f/benefits-medical-dental2.svg)

##### Peace of mind

We’ve got you covered with a generous benefits package that includes 100% paid medical, dental, and vision (75% for dependents).

[Read more](https://handbook.octopus.com/life-octopus/leave#healthcare-and-benefits-us)

![Arrow hitting the center of a target](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/78x76/af3c42834a/benefits-best-work-of-your-life2.svg)

##### A place to do the best work of your life

Trust is at the heart of how we work at Octopus. We hope you’ll do the best work of your life while you’re here.

[Read more](https://handbook.octopus.com/life-octopus/best-work-of-life)

![Belonging and Inclusion benefits](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/78x76/b9784895e2/benefits-belonging-and-inclusion-v3.svg)

##### Come as you are

We celebrate diversity, foster inclusion, and ensure everyone belongs - because our differences make us stronger.

[Read more](https://handbook.octopus.com/#belonging--inclusion-at-octopus-deploy)

![Kristen Hessenauer](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/686x430/ca891412dc/kristen-hessenauer.png/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))

I'm quite crafty and love making handmade gifts for friends and family. I make a variety of things from sublimated mugs to HTV shirts and pallet art.
